title: Revealing how phenytoin triggers liver damage and the potential protective effects of Balanites Aegyptiaca fruit extracts: Exploring Nrf2/MAPK/ Beclin-1 signaling pathways.
authors: Azzam, Shaimaa M; Abdel Khalek, Marwa Refaat; Abdel Rahman, Amina A S; Osman, Amany Abdelhameid; Selim, Heba Mohammed Refat M; Sharif, Asmaa Fady; El-Khattib, Yomna Ahmad; Rabea, Sameh; Ali, Sahar K; Darwish, Alshaymaa
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苯妥英诱导肝损伤及植物提取物保护作用，涉及Nrf2/MAPK/Beclin-1信号通路，仅用分子对接初步探索小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Phenytoin-induced liver injury (PHT ILII) is a serious condition that may necessitate discontinuation of the drug. This study investigates the mechanisms of PHT ILII and evaluates the protective effects of Balanites Aegyptiaca (BA) fruit extracts on the liver. We focus on the Nrf2/MAPK/NF-kappaB/Beclin-1 signaling pathways involved in oxidative stress and inflammation from drug-induced liver injury. Phytochemical analyses of BA fruit extracts (Bu-F and EA-F) are conducted. Molecular docking techniques explore the interaction between phenytoin (PHT) and the Nrf2/MAPK/NF-kappaB/Beclin-1 pathways. Thirty-six male rats are divided into Control, Bu-F, EA-F, PHT, Bu-F/PHT, and EA-F/PHT groups, and they are observed for 45 days. EA-F extract is rich in phenolics/flavonoids, while Bu-F extract mainly contains saponins.PHT ILII causes histological damage in liver tissues and affects Nrf-2, MAPK, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, Mcp-1, Beclin-1, iNOS expression, and liver function markers (ALT, AST, ALP). However, EA-F/Bu-F extracts effectively improve the histological structure and significantly reduce biochemical/immunohistochemical parameters, restoring them to near-normal levels. EA-F extract is particularly effective.In conclusion, the Nrf2/MAPK /Beclin-1 pathways play a critical role in the development of PHT ILII. BA fruit extracts show promise as hepato-protective agents, with the EA-F extract demonstrating superior efficacy. These results lay the groundwork for new treatments for PHT ILII and drug-induced liver injuries.
abstract_zh: 苯妥英诱导的肝损伤（PHT ILII）是一种严重状况，可能需要停用该药物。本研究探讨了PHT ILII的机制，并评估了埃及姜果（Balanites Aegyptiaca, BA）果实提取物对肝脏的保护作用。我们重点关注参与药物性肝损伤中氧化应激和炎症的Nrf2/MAPK/NF-kappaB/Beclin-1信号通路。对BA果实提取物（Bu-F和EA-F）进行了植物化学分析。分子对接技术探索了苯妥英（PHT）与Nrf2/MAPK/NF-kappaB/Beclin-1通路之间的相互作用。将三十六只雄性大鼠分为对照组、Bu-F组、EA-F组、PHT组、Bu-F/PHT组和EA-F/PHT组，并观察45天。EA-F提取物富含酚类/黄酮类化合物，而Bu-F提取物主要含有皂苷。PHT ILII导致肝组织学损伤，并影响Nrf-2、MAPK、TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、Mcp-1、Beclin-1、iNOS表达以及肝功能标志物（ALT、AST、ALP）。然而，EA-F/Bu-F提取物有效改善了组织学结构，并显著降低了生化/免疫组化参数，使其恢复至接近正常水平。EA-F提取物尤为有效。总之，Nrf2/MAPK/Beclin-1通路在PHT ILII的发展中发挥关键作用。BA果实提取物作为肝脏保护剂显示出潜力，其中EA-F提取物表现出更优的疗效。这些结果为PHT ILII及药物性肝损伤的新治疗方法奠定了基础。
